spec2def(msisys.ocx msisys.ocx.spec)

# msisys.ocx is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msisys-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(msisys_shims OBJECT msisys.c)
target_link_libraries(msisys_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(msisys_shims)
add_cargo_module(msisys msisys-cargo msisys.ocx
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msisys_shims psdk)
